title: Parity capture artifact (meta block + domains)
description: Envelope written by `php artisan parity:capture` (Laravel) and by the Python parity harness. The meta block describes the capture run; `domains` carries the per-domain signatures compared against the committed baseline. `content_hash` is sha256 over the canonical JSON of `domains` (keys sorted recursively, UTF-8, no insignificant whitespace, unescaped slashes/unicode) — recomputed by the gate before any diff.

schema_version.description: Artifact format version (semver). Gate rejects candidate when its major version exceeds the baseline's major version (VERSION_SKEW_FATAL).

source.description: Producing app. Baseline is python-fastapi; candidate is laravel.

generator.description: Command that produced the artifact, e.g. 'php artisan parity:capture'.

checklist.description: Repo-relative path of the human-readable checklist this run maps to.

gate.description: Gate identifier, e.g. 'PRD section 8, phase P5'.

roles.description: Role names exercised by the capture; must match the checklist role matrix.

domains.description: Declared domain keys. Gate invariant: exactly equals Object.keys(domains).

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 capture time. Gate invariant: within the artifact TTL (default 24h) when the gate runs.

content_hash.description: sha256 hex over canonical JSON of the `domains` value. Checksum check recomputes it; mismatch = CHECKSUM_MISMATCH.

normalization.description: Human-readable normalization contract applied to signatures (noise keys, tokenization, float rounding).

fixed_bugs.description: Previously known gaps that the baseline now captures as fixed behavior.

baseline_ref.description: Optional git ref / file path of the baseline this artifact was last compared against.

domains.description: Domain key -> fixture key -> capture signature. Domain key set must equal meta.domains.

status.description: HTTP status. null only when error is set (capture failed / unknown domain).

location.description: Redirect target, normalized to path only.

json.description: Normalized JSON body (noise keys stripped, floats rounded to 4dp).

data_strings.description: Whitespace-collapsed visible text nodes for 200 HTML responses.

rows_sample.description: First table's first 10 rows, td cells only.

error.description: Non-null marks a failed capture (status must then be null).
